text_block_list.text:
The day of Супер Крик's debut is finally
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she brushes that aside to celebrate
my debut
as a trainer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, remembering that she's the
one actually
running the race, Super
Creek sheepishly heads
out to make me
proud.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
